entities.name: Jund
entities.description: One of the five shards of Alara, red-aligned with black and green, of volcanoes and jungles where dragons dominate a creature-eat-creature world.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of five shards, of which Jund is one.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event in which blue and white mana flooded into Jund, disrupting its food chain, and the shards overlapped.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Alara was struck at Bant, Esper and Jund.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Leader of the Machine Legion that targeted Alara in the invasion.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: A presence that awoke during the invasion to fight on behalf of Alara.

entities.name: Dragons of Jund
entities.description: The apex predators of Jund, which perform the Shriek of Flame when too ancient to guard their territory.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Crocodile-like brutes second on Jund's food chain, organized into tribes called Thrashes.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara that captured the Bloodhall and overlaid the Eternal Crags during the Conflux.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara struck in the invasion.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara struck in the invasion.

entities.name: The Bloodhall
entities.description: A sangrite-rich cavern sacred to Jund's human warrior-clans where humans gather for the Life Hunt; captured by Grixis during the Conflux.

entities.name: Mount Jhal
entities.description: The place where Malactoth's lair was located.

entities.name: Malactoth
entities.description: A dragon of Jund whose lair held the Obelisk of Jund.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A shaman who revealed the Obelisk of Jund in Malactoth's lair.

entities.name: The Worldheart Chalice
entities.description: The volcanic lair of Nicol Bolas filled with sangrite shards.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker whose lair is the Worldheart Chalice.

entities.name: Highclan Tol Hera
entities.description: A small human tribe led by Javid Hera that believes in constant war against the dragons and consumes sangrite.

entities.name: Javid Hera
entities.description: The impetuous leader of Highclan Tol Hera.

entities.name: Riftclan Tol Breot
entities.description: A human clan led by Breot the Slayer, half of which was transported to Grixis during the Conflux.

entities.name: Breot the Slayer
entities.description: The leader of Riftclan Tol Breot.

events.summary: The Conflux floods Jund with blue and white mana, disrupting its food chain and making its creatures less violent and more thoughtful.
events.quote: When the Conflux occurred, blue and white mana flooded into Jund.

events.summary: During the Conflux, Grixis captures the Bloodhall and overlays the Eternal Crags, which crumble to dust.
events.quote: Captured by Grixis during the Conflux

events.summary: Half of Riftclan Tol Breot is transported to Grixis during the Conflux.
events.quote: Half the clan was transported to Grixis during the Conflux

events.summary: Alara is struck at Bant, Esper and Jund as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

events.summary: The Maelstrom awakens to fight on behalf of Alara.
events.quote: the Maelstrom itself awoke to fight on behalf of Alara.

relations.note: Jund is one of Alara's five shards.
relations.quote: is one of five shards of Alara
led by the impetuous Javid Hera
Alara as was targeted by Elesh Norn
